entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Colorless astral beings from the Blind Eternities who materialized on Zendikar, led by three legendary titans.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi titans, whose brood lineage inherited his traits.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi titans, leader of the Ulamog brood lineage.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: One of the three legendary Eldrazi titans, leader of the Emrakul brood lineage.

entities.name: Eldrazi Drones and Spawn
entities.description: Races that sprang up around the three Eldrazi titans, each inheriting traits from its leader and from Zendikar's mana.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane onto which the Eldrazi materialized; home of explorers, giants and hurdas.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The astral space from which the Eldrazi come.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Legendary location on Zendikar whose magic holds the Eldrazi; unlocked by Chandra's fire.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon whose colorless 'sheer fire' was the key to controlling the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker who gained the ability to wield colorless fire to unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic.

entities.name: Ghostfire
entities.description: Colorless fire magic, treated as the magic of Ugin rather than Eldrazi magic.

entities.name: Awakenings
entities.description: Comic in which Chandra unlocks the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Turntimber Forest
entities.description: Ancient wood on the continent of Ondu, home to a race of giants.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar containing Turntimber Forest.

entities.name: Ondu Giant
entities.description: Green giants living in Turntimber Forest, possibly descended from Druids.

entities.name: Hurdas
entities.description: Bestial pack-animal race of giantkind on Zendikar.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker, mentioned as a being a player can summon.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker listed among the powerful forces.

events.summary: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire, which lets her unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic.
events.quote: Chandra gains the ability to wield colorless fire in order to unlock the Eye of Ugin in the Awakenings comic

events.summary: The Eldrazi titans are lured out of the aether and bound to Zendikar for thousands of years.
events.quote: luring the Eldrazi titans out of the aether and binding them to a world for thousands of years

events.summary: Eldrazi materialize on Zendikar and their brood lineages spring up around the three titans.
events.quote: Even when they materialized into Zendikar, their bizarre forms still had no particular resonance with any of the five colors

relations.note: Eldrazi are astral beings from the Blind Eternities
relations.quote: strange astral beings from the Blind Eternities

relations.note: a race of giants has persisted in the forest for centuries
relations.quote: a race of giants has persisted there under its twining trunks for centuries

relations.note: Turntimber Forest is on the continent of Ondu
relations.quote: the Turntimber Forest of the continent of Ondu is an ancient wood
